verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a machine-readable OpenAPI spec publicly downloadable at https://workos.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains the "openapi" key), which directly delivers the story. Supporting machine-readable docs (llms.txt, docs.md) were also reachable. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or advertising the spec, and evidence of the spec's coverage, completeness, or versioning across WorkOS APIs.
